programs.desc: The No. 6 Fighting Irish face a tough test in the No. 10 Hurricanes. Miami won the last meeting, 41-8 in 2017. Notre Dame came up short against Ohio State 34-23 in the national title game last season. Miami was ranked as high as No. 4 in 2024.

programs.title: College Football
programs.desc: The Gators visit the No. 4 Hurricanes in a Florida Cup contest. In 2024, Miami won the first renewal of the three-way rivalry series in five years, beating Florida 41-17 in the process. Miami comes off a 49-12 beatdown of then-No. 18 South Florida.

programs.title: College Football
programs.desc: The No. 3 Hurricanes visit the No. 18 Seminoles. Miami leads the rivalry series 36-33 after beating Florida State 36-14 in 2024. FSU is coming off a double-overtime loss to Virginia on Sept. 26. Miami last played Sept. 20, beating Florida 26-7.

programs.title: College Football
programs.desc: The No. 18 Hurricanes seek a bounce-back effort when they host the Orange. Miami's College Football Playoff hopes have taken a hit after losing two of the past three games. Syracuse disrupted Miami's 2024 CFP run with a 42-38 upset Nov. 30, 2024.

programs.title: College Football
programs.desc: The Wolfpack set out to play spoiler once more by visiting the No. 15 Hurricanes. NC State upset then-No. 8 Georgia Tech 48-36 prior to its bye Nov. 1. Freshman Jayden Scott (NCSU) scored and set a new career high with 196 rushing yards in the win.

programs.title: College Football
programs.desc: The No. 13 Hurricanes (8-2, 4-2 ACC) seek their fifth straight victory over the Hokies (3-7, 2-4). Miami has won three of its last four games following a 41-7 win over NC State. Virginia Tech quarterback Kyron Drones has accounted for 25 touchdowns.

programs.title: College Football
programs.desc: The No. 22 Panthers (8-3, 6-1) host the No. 12 Hurricanes (9-2, 5-2) in a clash of ACC title game contenders. Pitt needs a victory, and a loss by SMU or Virginia to play for the championship. Miami must win, and have Virginia Tech win or Duke lose.
